ya97a85c6b8c.add: - **Finance Ministers who became President**: **R. Venkataraman** (FM 1980–82) and **Pranab Mukherjee** (FM 1982–84, 2009–12); Zail Singh had been **Home Minister**.

ydd22246eaf6.add: - **Record vote**: **K.R. Narayanan (1997)** – about **95%** (9.56 lakh vote value, the highest ever) against T.N. Seshan; by share alone **Rajendra Prasad (1957)** polled about 99%.

y730138166f1.add: - **Recent contests**: **2017** – Ram Nath Kovind (NDA) beat **Meira Kumar** (UPA); **2022** (16th election) – **Droupadi Murmu** (NDA) beat **Yashwant Sinha** (joint opposition, incl. Congress).

y898657b710a.add: - **V.V. Giri – trade-union leader**: founder-general secretary of the **All India Railwaymen's Federation**, **AITUC president** twice (1926, 1942), Union **Labour Minister** (1952–54).

y491b42f69af.add: - **President linked to the Trade Union Movement** = **V.V. Giri** only – not N. Sanjiva Reddy, K.R. Narayanan or Zakir Husain.
